code:
start: |00>

step 1, H on qubit 1:
(|0>+|1>)/sqrt2 (x) |0> = (|00> + |10>) / sqrt2

step 2, CNOT(q1 -> q2):
|00> term: control=0, target unchanged -> |00>
|10> term: control=1, target flips -> |11>

result: (|00> + |11>) / sqrt(2) = |Phi+>
caption: Hadamard on qubit 1, then CNOT — the standard entangling circuit in every quantum SDK.

code:
measure qubit 1 of |Phi+>:
P(q1=0) = 0.5 -> state is EXACTLY |00>
P(q1=1) = 0.5 -> state is EXACTLY |11>

P(00) = P(11) = 0.5
P(01) = P(10) = 0   (exactly)
caption: Qubit 1 alone is a fair coin — the remarkable part is qubit 2's outcome becomes certain the instant qubit 1's is known.
